title: Everything lives in a class
prompt:
Julian insists on a proper introduction.

In Java, all code lives inside a class, and the program starts in a method called main. Finish main so it prints exactly:

Pleased to meet you, Julian.
hints: System.out.println("some text"); prints a line. Don't forget the semicolon!
Inside main, add: System.out.println("Pleased to meet you, Julian.");
